requirement: The system shall lock a user account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts and display the remaining lockout time to the user.
note: Specific actor/action/object, measurable thresholds (5 attempts, 15 minutes), testable, single obligation.

requirement: The system shall provide a user-friendly and secure login page that is fast.
note: Vague subjective terms ('user-friendly', 'secure', 'fast') with no measurable criteria; not testable.

requirement: The system shall return search results within 2 seconds for queries over a catalogue of up to 50,000 products, displaying 20 results per page.
note: Quantified time limit, scale, and pagination; verifiable.

requirement: The system shall allow users to search for products by name and show the matching results.
note: Clear actor/action but missing performance, ranking, and empty-result behaviour; incomplete.

requirement: The system shall accept document uploads of type .pdf or .docx up to 10 MB, and reject other types or larger files with a descriptive error message.
note: States valid ranges, accepted types, and error handling; complete and testable.

requirement: The system shall let a student upload an SRS and automatically generate a sprint backlog while also notifying the instructor.
note: Compound requirement bundling three obligations ('upload', 'generate backlog', 'notify'); violates atomicity — should be split.

requirement: The system shall notify the relevant people when an error occurs.
note: Ambiguous: 'relevant people' and 'an error' are undefined; not specific or testable.

requirement: The system shall generate a PDF report of all requirements and their quality scores within 5 seconds of the user requesting it.
note: Single obligation, measurable time limit, clear output; verifiable.
No actor, action, or measurable criterion; untestable non-functional aspiration.

requirement: The system shall maintain 99.5% uptime measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance announced 24 hours in advance.
note: Quantified non-functional requirement with a clear, measurable target and exclusion.

requirement: The system shall allow an instructor to override a blocked requirement, recording the instructor's identity and the timestamp of the override.
note: Specific actor, action, and auditable outcome; traceable and testable.

requirement: The system shall support different user roles with appropriate permissions.
note: 'Appropriate' is vague and the roles/permissions are unspecified; needs enumeration to be complete and testable.
